title: Salt and Sigil
author: Isandro Okafor
blurb: Marguerite Sterling, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
